model: classical 3D occupied-FCC cubic wells with zero-point-only Hartree shift; shell-isotropic minimum-image continuation of periodic DFT sums

loading_law.meaning: occupancy changes sites/bonds only; well/J environment law has not been supplied

strain_map: measured collective DeltaK represented as a diagonal coarse-grained correction, not a computed local Kii derivative; no zero-strain recalibration
representation: layer-adapted FCC, periodic in-plane and selectable periodic/open depth; isotropic shell continuation, not unique infinite-lattice force constants
PSD_definition: one-sided Hann PSD; collective mean plus mean local probe PSD; resolution is record-window limited

results.label: Ni_x0.5_e0_random
results.classification: finite-window dominant channel: amplitude threshold.05A; patterned if>5% active and a connected S(q) peak carries>2% total
results.strain_profile: periodic in-plane sinusoid; input maximum |d epsilon/d in-plane coordinate| in1/nm
results.geometry: r/a=CELL@index, CELL=[[1,-1,1],[1,1,0],[0,0,1]]/2; layer index=k is(001); reference geometry
results.tensor_semantics: optional Cartesian symmetric per-site delta to effective curvature; no generated physical moire map

regions.definition: nearest-FCC connected displacement-amplitude regions above.05A; polarization/phase texture reported separately by S(q), NOT coherent domain radii
